resources.string: Write from GateControl to contacts in other messengers
Write from GateControl to contacts in other services. Your accounts there stay as they are.
No service is switched on for linking on this server right now.
Really unlink %1$s? The bridge signs out of %1$s; your account there stays as it is.
WhatsApp ended the link – for example because the phone was offline for more than 14 days or the device was removed in WhatsApp.
The link reports an error. Unlink it and link again if this does not go away.
Locked for your account until your parents allow this service.
The bridge is being started – this can take a few minutes.
The bridge does not answer right now. Please try again later.
A new code is enough. The service may deliver messages from the time in between when linking; this is not guaranteed.
Bridge outdated. The bridge for %1$s is older than intended. Receiving and sending may fail until it is updated.
Your administrator does the update – you do not have to link anything again.
You can unlink here or right in the service’s app under “Linked devices”.
In this version accounts can be linked. The chats with the service’s contacts follow in a later version.
The bridge is not an official program of WhatsApp. The terms of use allow access with the service’s own programs only.
WhatsApp can ban accounts. With normal use this is rare according to the bridge’s developers – it cannot be ruled out.
Your phone has to be online at least every 14 days, otherwise WhatsApp signs the bridge out.
WhatsApp’s end-to-end encryption ends at the bridge on your GateControl server. Whoever has root access there can technically read along; the interface lets nobody.
I have read this and link my own account at my own risk.
A note, not a ban – you decide.
With the country code, for example +49 for Germany. The number goes to the bridge and is not stored in the messenger.
Please enter the number with its country code, for example +49 1512 0000000.
That did not work with this number. Please check it and try again.
“Link a device” › “Link with phone number instead”
The code is valid only briefly and is stored nowhere.
Show this code on a second screen and scan it with WhatsApp on your phone:
“Link a device” and scan the code
Only this phone at hand? Then take “With a code” – a phone cannot scan its own screen.
Waiting for the confirmation on the phone …
The code ran out before it was confirmed.
The bridges are switched off on this server.
The bridge does not answer right now.
GateControl cannot show this sign-in step. Please choose the other way (code or QR code).
The bridge refused. Please start again from the beginning.
This service is locked for your account until your parents allow it.
Please read and confirm the notes first.
Code copied – it is removed from the clipboard after a minute.
The linked services could not be loaded.
